title: Pen alone
rule: The whole page drawn in the shared pen hand alone: one line weight, no tone, no fill.
declares: keeps E0-E5, the four lines and the outcome

lines.question: Pardon me — have you the right time?
lines.answer: Ten past four, by the clock.
lines.forgetting: Well, here I am... and what for?

made: eight panels after the base page's order, every mark in the shared pen hand at one width (the folio pen, 4.42 px)

figures and set drawn as pen outlines of page 05's HANDMADE figure model (b1m2.agent with spectacles, waistcoat, sleeve garter and pencil; b1m2.stranger with her hat and bow; desk, ticket window, clock at 4:10, cupboard, SERVICE door), hidden lines lifted (each nearer shape erases the lines behind it before its outline is drawn: bare paper, never fill); thin parts (slits, ticks, pencil, garter) drawn as single centre lines, tiny rounds opened to rings
the brass key drawn in outline (hook, bow ring and eye, shank, bit) with its SERVICE tag on a string
balloons as pen outlines with the four canon lines verbatim; MEMO, TICKET OFFICE and SERVICE lettered in boxes
the LoC 1934 sheet as the only ground

events.E0: P1 at the desk with the memo; P2 risen and walking; P3 walking past the closed cupboard and the SERVICE door
events.E1: P4: she behind the TICKET OFFICE window; question balloon
events.E2: P5: the clock at 4:10; answer balloon
events.E3: P6: she turned away; thanks balloon
events.E4: P7: the cupboard open, the key on its hook tagged SERVICE
events.E5: P8: pencil to chin, forgetting balloon; key on its hook; SERVICE door shut

beat: the page is drawn as by one pen: the frames ruled first, then the panels in reading order; the cupboard drawn shut and then redrawn open; the forgetting balloon written last
beat_frames: b05: panel 7 with the cupboard shut
b06: panel 7 with the cupboard open, the key on its hook
b08: the forgetting balloon written (= the page)

self_check.one_weight: every mark is the one pen: drawing strokes 4.42 px (13 px at 3x supersampling), lettering at weight = 4.42 / cap for every size (44 px balloons, 50 px thanks, 25 px memo, 30 px TICKET OFFICE / SERVICE, 24 px key tag), the folio's own pen (34 px x 0.13)

measured_stroke_width_px_on_master.note: thresholded at L<110 incl. anti-aliasing; wider readings only at line junctions

self_check.no_tone_no_fill: no fills, hatching, shadows, slips or photographs; balloons are pen outlines on the bare sheet
self_check.pending: independent blind reading not run by the maker
